title: Tunisian Beef Fajitas
description: Spicy fajitas with Tunisian flavors, served with warm flour tortillas.

ingredients.name: Tunisian beef strips
ingredients.notes: Slice the beef into thin strips

ingredients.name: Optional toppings: avocado, sour cream, cilantro

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced peppers and stir-fry sauce, and cook until the peppers are tender.
Add the tangy red wine vinegar and cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing the beef and pepper mixture onto a tortilla, and adding your desired toppings.
